purpose: Automated retrieval plan for the R2 data gate and the REAL_TIME evaluation (protocol v4, D-132). Every series is registered OPEN; retrieval is one series per request, rate-limited, without the FRED API service. Latest files come from the public FRED CSV endpoint. Vintage sets come from the ALFRED download-data form: the planned dates are a dense quarter-end grid 1990-03-31..2026-09-30 (147 dates); each planned date is mapped to the latest ACTUAL ALFRED vintage date at or before it (never a future date), the mapped dates are requested in batches of at most 40 per form POST, and the zipped CSVs are merged into one archive with one column per vintage (vintage_check: no observation later than its vintage date). The plan also carries the BEA/BLS/Fed/Census series needed for the world-core calibration and the V2 expenditure checks (docs/92): the same 147 quarter-end dates are planned for them, but ALFRED vintage depth differs by series (for example A191RL1Q225SBEA vintages start in 2014 and RSAFS in 2001; the planned dates before the first actual vintage stay unmapped and are reported in the log). The R2 gate checks a compact spot-check view of the archive (at most 36 dated columns spanning 1990-2026, at least 18 of them before 2000) because a form request carries a limited number of dates.
